# Full environment lock for the reference run.
#
# requirements.txt pins the direct dependencies and is what a reader should
# install. This file records EVERY installed package, generated by
# `pip freeze` in the environment that produced the committed artefacts.
#
# Reference environment:
#   Python 3.14.5, AMD64, Windows 11
#   BLAS: scipy-openblas 0.3.34.0.0
#
# Why this file exists: rebuilding from requirements.txt alone reproduces the
# stored predictions only to about 1e-16, because floating-point summation
# order depends on the installed BLAS build. That difference cannot affect any
# reported figure (all are quoted to at most four decimals), and
# tests/test_encodings.py::TestReferenceRunRegression asserts agreement to
# 1e-12 rather than pretending bit-identity holds across rebuilds.
# Determinism WITHIN one environment is asserted by tests/test_reproducibility.py.
